title: Choose the visual world for the eATL site — bolder hand
question: Bolder hand: four foreign forms fused with eATL. Keep the lead, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Akari Light Log
options.thesis: Each ATL section is a folded washi volume that lights from inside when it is signed; unsigned sections hang folded flat.
options.viewport: A dim room, a tall paper column printed with the ATL record glowing on as the commander signs; CONTACT stamped in vermilion.
options.risk: Calm and crafted where you asked for brutal; operators may not read the lamp as a log.

raised.raise: Status signals are drawn directly onto the paper skin, never placed as badges.
Every glowing volume stays a real, readable table of ATL fields underneath its motion.

options.label: Fuselage Skin
options.lineage: vinyl wraps and aircraft livery panels
options.thesis: The page is the aircraft's skin: panels are the layout, the registration is the headline, and ATL data lands as stencilled placards across the seams.
options.viewport: The parked aircraft side-on at full width, YU-RDA painted across door and seam; scrolling walks along the fuselage while the ATL record stencils onto the panels.
options.case: Beats the lead on both axes: operators live with their aircraft's skin and registration, and the record visibly belongs to that airframe.
options.risk: Needs a convincing authored aircraft drawing; a weak drawing collapses it into clip-art.

options.label: Xerox Tech-Log Zine
options.thesis: The paper log at its most brutal: ransom headlines, toner grit, biro entries; every copy degrades, except the eATL record, which never does.
options.viewport: A slapped-down photocopied ATL sheet, EATL cut from three newspapers, entries scrawled in biro, a day-glo pink CONTACT scrap.
options.case: Beats the lead on both axes: it is literally the paper problem eATL replaces, and it is the brutality you asked for.
options.risk: Anarchic tone can undercut trust with accountable managers if the product sections are not crisp.

options.label: Signature Jackfield
options.thesis: The hash chain drawn as amber tie lines on black glass: unbroken is signed, a gap is void, a doubled line is an amendment.
options.viewport: Numbered lanes 01–48 drifting, each a field of the ATL record tied by an amber line to its signature.
options.case: Unmatched clarity for the hash chain; loses on identification since operators do not know patch bays.
options.risk: Austere, reads as an engineering diagram.

options.label: Chromatophore Skin
options.viewport: A pale skin rippling with signals.
options.case: Biology register; no bridge to logs or aircraft.
options.kept: Signals drawn directly onto the surface.

options.label: Split-Flap Concourse
options.case: Same world you just passed on in the first hand.
options.kept: A semantic table under every animation.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: Aviation SaaS done impeccably: deep navy, iPad mockup, feature grid, sky photography.
canonCard.viewport: Headline left, iPad with the app right, logo strip below.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every MRO and EFB vendor by design.
